fields.acceptance: healthCache tracks each refresh healthCache.get starts with an unexported WaitGroup or in-flight counter, and TestWebRootHandlerServesEveryProject (plus any other internal/api test serving a page that reaches WebDaemonSource) waits for in-flight refreshes in a t.Cleanup registered after its t.TempDir calls, with no sleep, retry, exported API, synchronous refresh or change to WebRootHandler's signature; go test -trimpath -count=50 -run TestWebRootHandlerServesEveryProject ./internal/api/ passes, and go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestWebRoot|TestWebDaemon|TestWebHealth' -count=1 and go test -trimpath ./internal/web -count=1 pass
fields.statement: internal/api's web tests that serve pages wait for every background health refresh the web UI started before their temp folders are removed, so TestWebRootHandlerServesEveryProject no longer fails with 'TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: directory not empty'; the web UI still answers at once from the held report and refreshes in the background
